grammarFocus: much / many / a little / a few；数量表达；should / should not。
title: At the Fruit and Vegetable Market
instructions: 这是一个模拟的英语听力练习，不是官方雅思考试。请先听录音（或阅读录音稿），然后回答10个问题。题目包括单选题和填空题。填空题的答案必须来自录音原文，且不超过规定的字数。所有解释均为中文。
transcript:
Woman: Good morning! Can I help you?
Man: Yes, please. I want to buy some fruit and vegetables. But I don't know what to choose.
Woman: OK. What do you usually eat at home?
Man: I eat a lot of rice. And I eat many vegetables, like carrots and tomatoes. But I eat many sweets too. I love chocolate.
Woman: I see. You should eat more fruit. You should not eat many sweets every day. Sweets are not good for your teeth.
Man: You're right. I should buy some fruit. How much are these apples?
Woman: They are two dollars for one kilo. And these oranges are very sweet. They are three dollars for one kilo.
Man: OK. I should buy a few apples and a few oranges. And I need a little sugar for my tea. Do you have sugar?
Woman: Yes, we do. But you should not put much sugar in your tea. A little sugar is OK.
Man: OK, I understand. I should buy only a little sugar. And I should not buy many sweets.
Woman: Good. Do you want some bananas too? They are one dollar for one kilo.
Man: No, thank you. I have a few bananas at home. I should eat them first.
Woman: That's a good idea. So, you want a few apples, a few oranges, and a little sugar. Is that right?
Man: Yes. Oh, and how much time do I need to cook dinner? I have only 20 minutes.
Woman: Only 20 minutes? Then you should buy these small tomatoes. They cook very fast.
Man: Great. I should buy a few small tomatoes too. Thank you for your help!
Woman: You're welcome. Have a nice day!

grammar.title: much / many / a little / a few；数量表达；should / should not
grammar.explanation: much 用于不可数名词（如 sugar, water），many 用于可数名词复数（如 sweets, apples）。a little 表示“一点”，用于不可数名词；a few 表示“几个”，用于可数名词复数。should 表示“应该”，should not 表示“不应该”，用来给建议。注意：肯定句中常用 a lot of 代替 much/many。
grammar.example: You should not eat many sweets every day.

questions.explanation: apples 是可数名词复数，应该用 a few 表示“几个”。
questions.evidence: I have a few bananas at home.

options: You should not drink much coffee.
You should not drink many coffee.
You should not drink a few coffee.
answers: You should not drink much coffee.
questions.explanation: coffee 是不可数名词，应该用 much 表示“很多”。
questions.evidence: you should not put much sugar in your tea.

options: She should eat a little rice.
She should eat a few rice.
answers: She should eat a little rice.
questions.explanation: rice 是不可数名词，应该用 a little 表示“一点”。
questions.evidence: I need a little sugar for my tea.

options: You should not buy many sweets.
You should not buy much sweets.
You should not buy a little sweets.
answers: You should not buy many sweets.
questions.explanation: sweets 是可数名词复数，应该用 many 表示“很多”。
questions.evidence: You should not eat many sweets every day.
